newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest hogs sell steady-up $0.50 - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest hogs sell steady-up $0.50 - trade.

text.p: Midwest direct cash hog prices early Monday were mostly steady, instances $0.50 per cwt higher in slow trading early, livestock dealers said.
Interior Iowa/southern Minneosta buyers said hog prices were steady, with a top of $57.00 in the country and $58.00 for hogs delivered to plants.

Illinois buyers said hogs sold steady to up $0.50, with a top of $58.00 in the country and $59.00 at plants. Indiana and Ohio sources said prices were steady to up $0.50, with Indiana tops at $54.00 in the country and $57.50 at plants. Ohio hog tops were $54.00 in the country and $57.00 at plants.
